headline: Staging bucket is well-designed for its stated purpose: temporary storage with automatic cleanup
suppressed: CKV_AWS_300 and CKV2_AWS_62 are not concerns here. CKV_AWS_300 flags the lack of multipart upload abort configuration, but objects in this bucket expire after 1 day anyway, so incomplete uploads clean up automatically. CKV2_AWS_62 requires event notifications on all buckets, but a temporary staging bucket does not need them—the worker can poll or use other discovery mechanisms. Neither rule applies to a 24-hour expiration bucket.
